# Final Finish Epoxy

Final Finish Epoxy was founded by Denis and does quality floor makeovers in Edmonton, Alberta. It is a service-area business with no published street address. The website presents residential and commercial floor-coating services, real project photographs, finish inspiration, and educational planning resources.
